warnings: Alternative footings for sites that use prestressed piles (remark on sheet 1; sheet 3's handwritten note and sheet 2's province list say which sites). Same marks F1/F2/F3 as the pile-group footings on sheet 3 (หน้า04_view5), kept in their own file so the two designs never share an element_id within one file; the plans do not say which design applies where — sheet 3 governs the drawn footings.

F1: 0.75 x 1.50 (not square -> depth_mm), mat '7-Ø15 (ทางยาว) และ 10-Ø15 (ทางสั้น)' -> count 17 (section 0.5/6b). F2/F3: printed together as one spec; '5-Ø15 มม.#' read as 5 bars each way (# = two-way mesh) -> count 10, flagged.
The walkway slab spec is printed on the architectural floor plan and repeated on the cross-section; recorded here as an unmarked slab.
